```{r , echo=FALSE}
Uniontable <- read.csv(params$Dataframe)
datatable(
  Uniontable,
  options = list(
    lengthMenu = c(5, 10, 15, 20),
    dom = 'Blfrtip',
    buttons = list(
      'copy',
      'csv',
      list(extend = 'colvis', text = 'Column Visibility')
    )
  ),
  extensions = 'Buttons'
)
```


```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
Uniontable %>% 
  download_this(
    output_name = paste0(Sys.Date(), "_Annotated_Putative_Venom_Transcript_Dataframe_", Name),
    output_extension = ".csv",
    button_label = "Download distinct transcript as csv",
    button_type = "primary",
    csv2 = FALSE,
  )
```
